name: FlorisBoard
label: FlorisBoard
summary: Continues Floris-OH, the hand-written FlorisBoard input method for OpenHarmony, with FlorisBoard's settings app limited to what the OpenHarmony keyboard can apply: a Home screen (the base's setup page: IME status, the system input-method picker, a field to try the keyboard, and a row per settings screen), Keyboard (number row, hint symbols, font size, keyboard height), Sounds & Vibration (haptic feedback on/off and duration), Typing (auto-capitalization, double-space period), Theme (follow system, always day, always night), Languages & Layouts (English with QWERTY, QWERTZ or AZERTY) and About. All settings live in one Preferences file shared by the app and the input method process; the keyboard reloads it every time its panel shows and applies every setting, names the active layout on the space bar ('English (QWERTZ)') and gives every key an id so flows can type with it.

design.navigation: a settings home with grouped rows (chevrons) that push each settings screen on a stack; Sounds & Vibration is pushed from a row on Keyboard; the system Back key and the app bar arrow go back
design.tone: FlorisBoard's own wording: plain, short, sentence case for summaries, title case kept where FlorisBoard uses it (Languages & Layouts, Sounds & Vibration), no exclamation marks

screens.name: Home
screens.title: Welcome to FlorisBoard
screens.purpose: FlorisBoard's settings home merged with the base's setup page: a status card saying whether FlorisBoard is enabled and selected as the input method, a button that opens the system's input-method picker, a text field to try the keyboard in, and one row per settings screen (Languages & Layouts, Theme, Keyboard, Typing, About) in FlorisBoard's order. No back arrow in the app bar.

ux.primaryAction: choose the keyboard: a filled button 'Choose keyboard' (id choose_keyboard) under the status card, which opens the system input-method picker and refreshes the status when the picker closes
ux.error: the status card (id ime_status) shows FlorisBoard's texts: when FlorisBoard is not enabled, 'FlorisBoard is not enabled in the system and thus won't be available as an input method in the input picker. Click here to resolve this issue.' in the error style; when enabled but not the current input method, 'FlorisBoard is not selected as the default input method. Click here to resolve this issue.' in the warning style; when it is the current one, 'FlorisBoard is enabled and selected.'; tapping the card opens the picker too; if the input-method list cannot be read the card says 'Could not read the input method list.'

screens.name: Keyboard
screens.title: Keyboard
screens.purpose: The keyboard's look and size: the number row on or off ('Number row', 'Show a number row above the character layout'), hint symbols on the keys on or off ('Hinted symbols'), the font size multiplier (50% to 150%, step 5) and, under the group 'Layout', the keyboard height (50% to 150%, step 5); under the group 'Key press', a row 'Sounds & Vibration' that opens the input feedback screen. Changes are saved at once.

screens.name: InputFeedback
screens.title: Sounds & Vibration
screens.purpose: Haptic feedback, under the group 'Haptic feedback / Vibration': 'Enable haptic feedback' on or off (summary when off: 'Never vibrate for input events, regardless of system settings') and 'Vibration duration' (1 to 100 ms, step 1, shown as '50 ms'), disabled while haptic feedback is off; moving the slider plays one vibration of the chosen length as a preview. No sound feedback.

screens.name: Typing
screens.title: Typing
screens.purpose: Typing corrections: 'Auto-capitalization' ('Capitalize words based on the current input context') and 'Double-space period' ('Tapping twice on spacebar inserts a period followed by a space'), each a switch, saved at once.

screens.name: Theme
screens.title: Theme
screens.purpose: The keyboard's theme mode, under 'Theme mode': one radio row each for 'Follow system', 'Always day' and 'Always night' (Floris Day and Floris Night named in the summaries); the choice is saved at once.

screens.name: Localization
screens.title: Languages & Layouts
screens.purpose: FlorisBoard's localization screen reduced to one subtype: under the group 'Subtypes', the subtype English, and below it the characters layout to use, one radio row each for QWERTY, QWERTZ and AZERTY; the summary of the subtype row reads 'English (QWERTY)' with the chosen layout. Saved at once.

screens.name: About
screens.title: About
screens.purpose: What the app is: the app icon and name FlorisBoard, the version (the bundle's versionName, read with bundleManager), 'Project license' with 'FlorisBoard is licensed under Apache-2.0', 'Repository (GitHub)' with https://github.com/florisboard/florisboard, and 'FlorisBoard for OpenHarmony' naming this port. Rows only show text.

fPoints.description: Typing h and i in the empty field gives Hi: auto-capitalization is on by default and the keys carry their ids.
By default the space bar names the QWERTY layout and the top row shows its number hints.
With auto-capitalization off, typing h and i in the empty field gives hi.
With the number row on, key_1 is on the keyboard, tapping it types 1, and the letter row loses its number hints.
With hinted symbols off, the keys show no corner hints.
With QWERTZ chosen, the space bar names QWERTZ.
With AZERTY chosen, the space bar names AZERTY and the a key still types.
The Keyboard settings start at FlorisBoard's defaults: number row off, hinted symbols on, font size and height 100%.
The number row setting survives a restart of the app.
The chosen layout survives a restart of the app and the subtype row names it.
The theme mode follows the system by default; Always night is selected and survives a restart.
Haptic feedback is on with a 50 ms duration by default and can be turned off.
Auto-capitalization and double-space period are on by default; double-space period can be turned off and stays off after a restart.
About names the app and its licence.

constraints: ArkUI state management V2 only (@ComponentV2, @Local, @Param, @Event, @ObservedV2/@Trace) in the new screens and in the store; the base's keyboard files (KeyboardPage, KeyButton) are V1 (@Component, @State, @Prop) and stay V1 where the feature item does not need to change that: do not mix V1 and V2 decorators in one component.

All settings are persisted with @ohos.data.preferences in ONE file named 'florisboard_settings', with FlorisBoard's own preference keys (keyboard__number_row, keyboard__hinted_symbols_enabled, keyboard__font_size_multiplier_portrait, keyboard__height_factor_portrait, input_feedback__haptic_enabled, input_feedback__haptic_vibration_duration, correction__auto_capitalization, correction__double_space_period, theme__mode, localization__layout); every write is followed by flush() so the other process can read it.

The input method (InputMethodService, an InputMethodExtensionAbility) runs in its own process where EntryAbility does not run: it opens the store itself with SettingsStore.getInstance().init(this.context) in onCreate, and calls SettingsStore.getInstance().reload() each time its panel shows (Preferences caches per process; reload drops the cache with preferences.removePreferencesFromCacheSync and reads the file again).

The base's input method keeps working exactly as before: QWERTY + symbols + symbols2 + numeric layers, shift and caps lock, auto-capitalization, action-aware Enter, long-press accent popups, backspace auto-repeat, double-space period, haptic tick, Floris Day / Night colours from model/Theme.ets, the gesture-bar inset. Its files stay at their paths (inputmethodability/, components/KeyButton.ets, model/KeyModels.ets, model/LayoutStore.ets, model/Theme.ets, resources/rawfile/layouts/).

Every key of the keyboard carries an id: character keys key_<lowercase output> for letters and digits (key_q, key_h, key_1; the id does not change when shift shows the uppercase label), other character keys key_code_<code>; special keys key_shift, key_delete, key_enter, key_space, key_symbols (the ?123 view key), key_symbols2, key_characters (the ABC view key), key_numeric, key_lang. Ghost filler columns get no id. The id is set on the KeyButton's outermost node, the one that receives the touch. A key's corner hint Text has the id hint_<lowercase output> (hint_q).

Switch settings are ArkUI Toggle (type Switch) and choices are Radio components; the element id is set on the Toggle or Radio itself, so the selector id=number_row,checked=true reads its state, and tapping it changes the setting. Tapping the row's label does the same.
Sliders show their current value in a separate Text with its own id (font_size_value '100%', height_value '100%', haptic_duration_value '50 ms').

The Home screen's 'Choose keyboard' opens the system picker with inputMethod.getSetting().showOptionalInputMethods(); the status line reads inputMethod.getSetting().getInputMethods(true) (enabled) and inputMethod.getCurrentInputMethod() (selected), compared with the bundle name dev.patrickgold.florisboard; no flow depends on that system dialog.
No network access, no new permissions: the base's ohos.permission.VIBRATE stays declared for the haptic feedback.

Out of the port (capabilities none or excluded by the brief): suggestions and smartbar, glide typing, spell checking (FlorisSpellCheckerService), dictionaries and the UserDictionaryEntry table, clipboard history and ClipboardFileInfo, the emoji panel, gestures, one-handed mode, the theme editor and theme manager, backup and restore, physical keyboard, language packs and subtype editor, sound feedback, the crash dialog (CrashDialogActivity), the SEND share target (FlorisCopyToClipboardActivity) and notifications.

Floris Day and Floris Night are the base's colours in model/Theme.ets, used only by the keyboard; the app's screens use the factory's design system with FlorisBoard's green accent #4CAF50 and follow the system's light/dark mode.

Visual facts kept from FlorisBoard: the settings screens are lists of preference rows with a title and a one-line summary under it, grouped under small group headers (Layout, Key press, Haptic feedback / Vibration); the home has no back arrow.

stores.name: SettingsStore
stores.purpose: Keeps the keyboard settings (one KeyboardPrefs) in the Preferences file 'florisboard_settings' under FlorisBoard's keys, shared by the app's process and the input method's process; loaded in init, written and flushed by every setter, re-read from storage by reload.

methods.name: prefs
methods.does: Returns the one in-memory KeyboardPrefs instance loaded by init (defaults for keys not stored yet). Always the same object: setters and reload update its @Trace fields in place, so screens bound to it refresh.

methods.name: reload
methods.does: Drops this process's cached Preferences instance (preferences.removePreferencesFromCacheSync(context, 'florisboard_settings')), opens the file again, copies every stored value into the prefs() instance (defaults for missing keys) and returns it. The input method calls it each time its panel shows, so changes made in the app apply.

methods.name: setNumberRow
methods.does: Sets numberRow, writes keyboard__number_row and flushes.

methods.name: setHintedSymbols
methods.does: Sets hintedSymbols, writes keyboard__hinted_symbols_enabled and flushes.

methods.name: setFontSizePercent
methods.does: Rounds to the nearest multiple of 5, clamps to 50..150, sets fontSizePercent, writes keyboard__font_size_multiplier_portrait and flushes.

methods.name: setHeightPercent
methods.does: Rounds to the nearest multiple of 5, clamps to 50..150, sets heightPercent, writes keyboard__height_factor_portrait and flushes.

methods.name: setHapticEnabled
methods.does: Sets hapticEnabled, writes input_feedback__haptic_enabled and flushes.

methods.name: setHapticDurationMs
methods.does: Rounds to an integer, clamps to 1..100, sets hapticDurationMs, writes input_feedback__haptic_vibration_duration and flushes.

methods.name: setAutoCapitalization
methods.does: Sets autoCapitalization, writes correction__auto_capitalization and flushes.

methods.name: setDoubleSpacePeriod
methods.does: Sets doubleSpacePeriod, writes correction__double_space_period and flushes.

methods.name: setThemeMode
methods.does: Sets themeMode when mode is one of themeModes() ('follow_system', 'always_day', 'always_night'), writes theme__mode and flushes; an unknown mode is ignored.

methods.name: setLayout
methods.does: Sets layout when it is one of layouts() ('qwerty', 'qwertz', 'azerty'), writes localization__layout and flushes; an unknown layout is ignored.

methods.name: themeModes
methods.does: Returns ['follow_system', 'always_day', 'always_night'] in this order (the Theme screen's rows).

methods.name: themeModeName
methods.does: The label of a theme mode from the string resources: 'Follow system', 'Always day', 'Always night'; an unknown mode gives 'Follow system'.

methods.name: layouts
methods.does: Returns ['qwerty', 'qwertz', 'azerty'] in this order (the Languages & Layouts rows).

methods.name: layoutName
methods.does: The layout's name from the string resources: 'QWERTY', 'QWERTZ', 'AZERTY'; an unknown layout gives 'QWERTY'.

methods.name: spaceBarLabel
methods.does: The subtype name FlorisBoard shows on the space bar and in the subtype row: 'English (QWERTY)', 'English (QWERTZ)', 'English (AZERTY)'; an unknown layout gives 'English (QWERTY)'.

methods.name: layoutFile
methods.does: The rawfile base name under layouts/ of the characters layer for a layout: 'characters' for qwerty (the base's file), 'characters_qwertz', 'characters_azerty'; an unknown layout gives 'characters'.

methods.name: percentText
methods.does: Formats a percentage for the slider value labels: 100 gives '100%'.

methods.name: durationText
methods.does: Formats a vibration duration: 50 gives '50 ms'.

workItems.title: QWERTZ, AZERTY and number row layout data
workItems.description: Write the new keyboard data in the base's rawfile format (LayoutDef from model/KeyModels.ets: name, rows of keys with code, label, kind, weight, popups, hint), produced like the base's characters.json by extending tools/convert-layouts.js: characters_qwertz.json from FlorisBoard's layouts/characters/qwertz.json and characters_azerty.json from layouts/characters/azerty.json (app/src/main/assets/ime/keyboard/org.florisboard.layouts/), each merged with the same charactersMod row as the base's characters.json (shift, delete, ?123 view key, space, enter, with the same kinds, weights and targets), with the en.json accent popups and the number hints on the top row where FlorisBoard's popup mapping gives them, 4 rows like the base's; and number_row.json, one row of the ten keys 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8 9 0 (kind char, weight 1) from FlorisBoard's layouts/numeric_row/western_arabic.json with its popups. Keep the base's characters.json, symbols.json, symbols2.json and numeric.json unchanged. The JSON files must be valid and load with LayoutStore.load.

workItems.title: The keyboard obeys the settings
workItems.description: Make the base's input method read and apply SettingsStore. In InputMethodService.onCreate call SettingsStore.getInstance().init(this.context) before keyboardController.onCreate. Each time the panel shows (Panel.on('show') and InputHandler.onInputStart) call await SettingsStore.getInstance().reload(), then resize the panel and bump an AppStorage counter that KeyboardPage watches to re-apply: (1) layout: load the characters layer from SettingsStore.layoutFile(prefs.layout) via LayoutStore.load (LayoutStore's cache must key by file name, and loading a missing file falls back to 'characters'); (2) number row: when prefs.numberRow is on, the characters layer gets the row of layouts/number_row.json above its letter rows and the top letter row loses its digit hints; KeyboardController.panelHeight uses 5 rows instead of Metrics.visibleRows when the number row is on; (3) height: panelHeight multiplies the key rows' height by prefs.heightPercent / 100 (keep the clamp and the gesture-bar inset); (4) font size: every key font size and hint size multiplied by prefs.fontSizePercent / 100; (5) hinted symbols off: no corner hints; (6) haptics: KeyButton vibrates only when prefs.hapticEnabled, for prefs.hapticDurationMs ms instead of the fixed 16 (pass both as props from KeyboardPage); (7) auto-capitalization: evalAutoCap does nothing and shift stays unshifted when prefs.autoCapitalization is off; (8) double-space period: handleSpace only turns two spaces into '. ' when prefs.doubleSpacePeriod is on; (9) theme: 'always_day' uses FlorisLight, 'always_night' FlorisDark, 'follow_system' the existing dark-mode media query; (10) the space bar label is the string of SettingsStore.spaceBarLabel(prefs.layout) resolved with the resourceManager ('English (QWERTY)'). Give every key an id as the constraints say (key_q, key_1, key_shift, key_space, key_enter, key_delete, key_symbols, key_characters, ...; set on KeyButton's outermost node through a new keyId prop, none on ghost columns) and the hint Text the id hint_<char>. Everything the keyboard does today keeps working (shift and caps lock, accents, backspace repeat, Enter actions, per-session reset, gesture-bar inset).

Welcome to FlorisBoard screen

The data layer is being written at the same time as this screen: call the stores by their contract (the app spec's Data layer section) and do not read the files in model/, whose bodies are not written yet.
